_comment: Hand-curated layer of LinPad Store over store-index.json: home collections, hero banners and the 'Runs on LinPad' list. Entries name Alpine packages (aarch64, v3.21 main+community) or catalog.json pack ids prefixed with 'pack:'. compat status: works | experimental | broken; anything not listed shows 'Not tested'. 'verified' says where and when the status was checked.

pack:multimedia.note: LinPad's own Wayland video output and sound. Verified 2026-10-03: installed from the Store and opened its window on the release system (CLI emulator).

pack:vscode.note: Needs 2-3 GB of memory while running.

pack:office.note: Very large (about 500 MB with what it needs); the first start takes about a minute under emulation. Verified 2026-10-03: installed from the Store and opened its window on the release system (CLI emulator).

pack:browsers.note: Falkon does not start yet; Dillo works.

pack:wine-x86.note: Needs fast mode for usable speed.

filezilla.note: Opens natively on Wayland. Verified 2026-10-03: installed from the Store and opened its window on the release system (CLI emulator).

pack:image-editor.note: GIMP 2.10 runs in its own Xwayland. Verified 2026-10-03: installed from the Store and opened its window on the release system (CLI emulator).

inkscape.note: Verified 2026-10-03: installed from the Store and opened its window on the release system (CLI emulator).

audacity.note: Runs with LinPad fixups (iSH has no System V IPC, and a loader deadlock is avoided). The first start shows a plug-in scan; recording and playback were not tested. Verified 2026-10-03: installed from the Store and opened its window on the release system (CLI emulator).
